title: DreamTeam Project Profile v1
description: dreamteam.json at the repository root: the single home of everything project-dependent that the project-manager role, the four engineering roles and the tracker adapter read. Secrets never live here. Resolution of a policy value: this file, then the adapter's defaults, then the DreamTeam defaults (delivery branch, returns 2, base = the repository's default branch).

tracker.description: The tracker the project is served by. `kind` and `prefix` are checked by the project-manager role against the dispatcher that invoked it and the key of the command; every other key belongs to that tracker's adapter and is validated there. A key that looks like a secret is refused.

base.description: The base branch of ordinary tasks; a subtask's base is its parent branch.

delivery.description: merge_push: `сливай` merges the accepted task branch into the base and pushes it, there is no `пуш`. branch: `сливай` consolidates locally, `пуш` sends the task branch; the base is never merged or pushed by the role.

returns.description: Returns to development per run: red QA gates, failed branch migrations and review fixes counted together.

terminology.description: The project's terminology document the PRD interview reads, relative to the repository root.

checks.description: The QA gate: every command of the project's full check set, as the repository rules spell it, run from the checkout root on the host. A string item is the command; an object item adds a baseline policy.

baseline.description: files_outside_diff: diagnostics of this check that all name files outside the full diff of the task do not affect the verdict; the QA role marks the item passed with attribution baseline. Requires `diagnostic`.

diagnostic.description: A regular expression with a named group `file` that matches one diagnostic line of the tool's output and captures the file it names.

root.description: Every task tree lives at <primary>/<root>/<KEY>; the directory is git-ignored.

link.description: Paths symlinked from the primary into a fresh tree.

copy.description: Paths copied from the primary into a fresh tree.

setup.description: Commands run inside a fresh tree, in order; a non-zero exit stops the run and keeps the tree.
